Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Impressive! Really, a grill is a grill is a grill, right? You have never owned a Rolex or a Rolls Royce  have you. My old Weber Traveler Portable gas grill, a gift from a friend decided it was time for me to get a new grill and was limiting the gas to the burners. Initially I found a Weber video to problem solve and twice I thought repair was the solution, thanks to the Weber associate helping me. Secondary to the disastrous national leadership, supply chain issues blocked that, leaving replacement the best option. Not needing the portability of the model I had saving a little, I bought the Spirit II E-210 gas grill. During unpacking/assembly I was very impressed with the packaging and surprised when the right side panel was damaged. It could have only happened prior to or during packing as there was no damage of the packing materials, externally or internally. A call to Weber got a replacement part coming, but I was able to assemble the grill temporarily until the part arrived. Instructions were great and I had the grill working for dinner that day, yummy! When the replacement part arrived (in a VERY sturdy custom packing) it was less than 5 minutes to swap parts. I continue using this grill now every day. Thanks Weber!
Results.Title: Weber THE grill!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)

Results.ReviewText: This was our second E-210 purchase and we are very happy with it.  Only thing we did not like about the original E-210 is that it had a panel on the front that looked nice, but it was hard to loan/unload the propane tank underneath the grill itself.  It was difficult because one had to hold a new, full tank at arms length to hook it onto the mounting hook used for indication of the amount of fuel in the tank.  This was very awkward and required lots of strength.  We are in our 80s, and this was too difficult, so we opted for a E-210 configured with a tank mount on the outside where it is readily accessible.  We discarded the old version, even though it worked fine.
Results.Title: Excellent Grill with Accessible Tank Mount

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
